text:
nightly-eval-bot: Nightly eval run finished 2024-10-14T02:05Z. redwood-rlhf-v2-quant (quantized, cpu fallback) shows 14/120 prompt set regressions. Primary failure class: tool/function-calling JSON schema violations (invalid args/format). See summary: https://internal.eval/reports/1742158301

Anya: saw the summary, jumping in. quick glance at a few generations — function call payloads are being emitted as strings instead of objects. example from prompt id 2317:
```json
"tool_call": "{\"name\": \"lookup_price\", \"args\": \"{\\\"ticker\\\": \\\"AAPL\\\"}\"}"
```
This used to be an object: `{"name": "lookup_price", "args": {"ticker": "AAPL"}}`

Mike: that looks like double-serialization. could be an upstream `json.dumps` happening in the model output postproc or a tokenization artifact producing stray quotes. did this start after the quant rollout?

Anya: yes, quant rollout to ~20% yesterday. non-quantized baseline (redwood-rlhf-v2) passes these checks.

Raj: I reproduced locally with the quantized binary + python harness. running `./eval_harness --model redwood-rlhf-v2-quant --prompts prompts_batch_2317.json` yields the same double-quoted args in ~11/30 cases. log snippet:
```
[2024-10-14 02:12:34] generation: .. "tool_call": "{\"name\": \"fetch_user\", \"args\": \"{\\\"id\\\": 42}\"}"
```

Sophia: interesting. two hypotheses: 1) beam/decoding change with quant kernels causes the model to emit an extra string wrapper; 2) our function-calling postproc expects S-expr-style tokens and mis-parses now.

Mike: can we quickly check tokenizer/decoder flags? Raj, can you repro with `--force-gpt-style` and `--no-escape` flags?

Raj: running that now. update in 3 mins.

devops-bot: Deploys: quant rollout 2024-10-13 18:40 UTC -> traffic 20% (canary group). No recent infra changes.

Anya: also saw a few strict JSON schema failures where `args` missing required fields (e.g., `amount` missing in `transfer_funds`). The eval harness validates against the function schema and marks as failed. Example bad output:
```json
{"tool_call": {"name": "transfer_funds", "args": "{\"to\": \"acct_123\"}"}}
```
Expected: `{"to": "acct_123", "amount": 100}`

Mike: okay, immediate triage plan: 1) reproduce locally and log raw tokens + decoded string for failing examples, 2) run the same evals against the CPU non-quant model and the quant model with older kernel (if available), 3) if repros match, rollback canary to 0% and pause rollout.

Sophia: I'll add a temporary strict test in nightly that asserts `tool_call.args` parses to an object with required keys; fail fast to avoid silent regressions.

Raj: quick repro shows raw tokens around the tool call include an extra leading `"` token sometimes. dump attached (abbreviated):
```
... 50256("\")  12345({)  50122(name)  ...
```
so decoder is emitting a stray quote token.

Anya: that suggests kernel-level softmax rounding on quant path. we saw similar tiny token shifts in early quant experiments but they didn't affect function-call boundaries before. maybe the model used a brittle prompt template relying on exact quote tokens.

Mike: action items:
- Raj: collect 20 failing examples with raw token sequences, decoded outputs, and model seed. tag `ml/regressions/1742158301`. (ETA 1h)
- Anya: run eval-harness with `--emit-function-json` fallback to attempt reparsing double-serialized args into objects and measure how many would be rescued. (ETA 2h)
- Sophia: add strict schema test to nightly and run a quick backfill on last 7 nightly runs to see when this first appeared. (ETA 3h)
- Ops: pause canary if failure rate > 5% on full prompt suite.

Raj: starting collection. sample failing prompt list written to `/tmp/regressions_1742158301.txt` and uploaded to https://internal.logs/1742158301/dumps

devops-bot: Canary pause endpoint: https://internal.deploy/rollouts/quant-canary - requires two approvals.

Anya: if we find it's quant kernel rounding, plan B is to pin the kernel to previous version for canary while we debug. if it's postproc, patch is small.

Mike: good. keep this thread for updates. please prefix msgs with `[1742158301]` when posting results so the nightly-bot can correlate. :thumbsup:

Raj: [1742158301] uploaded CSV of 20 raw-token failures and grepable JSON examples. link: https://internal.logs/1742158301/examples.csv

Anya: [1742158301] quick experiment `--emit-function-json` rescued 9/14 failing cases in the canary sample. still not ideal but reduces user-impact. pushing patch to eval harness to auto-retry reparsing on string args. PR: https://internal.git/infra/eval-harness/pulls/412

Sophia: [1742158301] nightly strict test merged to branch `nightly/strict-toolcall` and scheduled. backfill job queued.

Mike: next checkin in 2h, if failure rate remains > 5% pause rollout. thanks all.
